Sorry—I can’t share my private chain-of-thought or internal step-by-step deliberations. I can, however, give a brief final answer and a concise, non-sensitive summary of the main considerations that led to it. If that works, tell me the question you want answered and I’ll respond that way.

I might be wrong about what level of detail you want in the summary—tell me if you prefer a one-sentence conclusion or a short bullet list of considerations.
